evidence: Snapshot comparison identified 52 added or modified files; the AppSpec fingerprint is unchanged.
WorkspaceRecoveryGate introduces a shared asynchronous recovery barrier before screen observation and execution.
LocalBackupService introduces persistent recovery archives, replacement serialization, compensation and startup recovery across database, preferences, photos and reminders.
AndroidProductionAppGraph connects workspace readiness to advertising and adds asynchronous environment reconciliation.
ReminderBroadcastWork introduces delivery claiming and rearming behavior; ReminderEnvironmentReconciliation connects timezone changes to persisted commands.
AndroidAdConnectivity introduces native default-network observation and callback lifecycle.
The changed-file set also includes iOS graph/storage, Store command handling, production data management, CI, localization resources and connected tests.
findings.failedLink: Previous acceptance evidence cannot establish current production behavior after shared execution, startup, recovery, storage, reminder and advertising lifecycle changes.

instructionBasis.quote: Request a fresh full audit if scope or independence no longer permits delta review.

findings.requiredChange: Request a fresh full independent audit against the current immutable snapshot. This is an audit-scope action, not a request to change implementation.
findings.smallestProof: A fresh auditor must reconstruct the normative inventory, trace current production entry points and dependency wiring, inspect meaningful assertions and current receipts, run missing safe checks, and return all 350 obligation pairs. priorFindingsReview.reason: Command contracts, Store execution, immediate preferences, production manager and root adapter changed; previous conclusions cannot be carried forward.
LocalDatabase, production manager and zone acceptance assertions changed; assignment and historical snapshot behavior needs new connected proof.
New Android connectivity and changes to advertising, projection and graph wiring require privacy-before-initialization and lifecycle reassessment.
Reminder contracts, broadcast delivery, environment reconciliation, Application and production graph changed across lifecycle boundaries.
Durable recovery and startup gating were introduced across backup, native storage and both platform graphs; this changes the architecture underlying previous evidence.
Cancellation and compensation changes span Store, privacy and backup code; source-level changes alone do not close the finding.
CI and platform wiring changed; native runtime and accessibility evidence has not been reassessed. Exact macOS host limitations remain recorded separately.
New connected tests and changed persistence fixtures require assertion inspection against the new production graph.
Asset metadata and catalog/design review documents changed; their claims and production correspondence require independent review.
CSV resources, localization adapter and export implementation changed. The approved specification is unchanged; the stricter behavior and assertions need reassessment.

requestedAction: Launch a fresh full independent acceptance audit of the current snapshot.

scopeReview.assessment: Delta eligibility review only. A full behavioral reassessment was not completed.
limitations: Snapshot hashes were compared for every recorded file. Every changed file and dependent behavior was not behaviorally audited after the broad-scope stop condition was established.
Normative inventory was regenerated from the approved AppSpec using canonical helpers. Supporting normative Markdown was not rereviewed during this scope-only assessment.
Prior findings were read, but none was closed or reconfirmed as a current implementation defect.
No Gradle or native runtime checks were run. Passing execution checks would not resolve the requirement for a fresh full independent review.
No source, tests, configuration, AppSpec, delivery state, audit artifacts or launch evidence were written.
